text.description_html:
First Impressions HNF01012AL, Hygienic Hands Free Door Pull

This Hands-Free Sanitary Door Pull is great for use in commercial settings. Use your arm to open the door instead of your hands, keeping everything hands free and hygienic. Perfect for office, hospital, school, and restroom doors. The Aluminum Arm Door Pull can be finished in brushed aluminum or satin brass.

The Hands Free Door Handle comes packaged with mounting hardware for wood, composite, or metal doors. Can be surface mounted or thru-bolt mounted to your door.

Features and Specifications of the First Impressions HNF01012AL Aluminum Arm Door Pull:

  • Material: Aluminum
  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Overall Projection: 4-3/8"
  • Clearance: 3-1/4"
  • Plate Height: 12"
  • Plate Width: 3"
  • Plate Thickness: 1/8"
  • For use on wood, composite, or metal doors.
  • Packaged with (1) door pull, (1) pull plate, and mounting screws.

Note: This door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Cancelable or Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold individually.
